title: Finch Circle Members' Registry Credit Bonus — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry
content:
**Member benefit.** The Finch Circle credit bonus is added, in percentage points, to the registry credit bonus percent of an order line to which the registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry applies registry credit (her or his own purchase record still in ordered status). It follows the registrant's membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program — its status and the tier it holds when the credit is applied:

- active at Finch Circle Diamond or Finch Circle Icon adds the upper circle credit bonus of **3** percentage points;
- active at Finch Circle Silver, Finch Circle Gold or Finch Circle Platinum adds the lower circle credit bonus of **1** percentage point;
- otherwise, for another tier or an inactive or absent membership, no Finch Circle credit bonus is added.

| Membership status | Tier | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| active | Finch Circle Icon | 3 |
| active | Finch Circle Diamond | 3 |
| active | Finch Circle Platinum | 1 |
| active | Finch Circle Gold | 1 |
| active | Finch Circle Silver | 1 |
| active | Finch Circle Member | none |
| not active, or no membership | — | none |

*Example (hypothetical):* a registrant whose Finch Circle membership is active at Gold applies registry credit to her order line; 1 percentage point of Finch Circle credit bonus is added. Had her membership been cancelled, none would be added, whatever tier it last held.
